translations.literal: When the king submitted memorials to the throne, he repeatedly remonstrated to stop the king; the king would not heed;
translations.idiomatic: When the king submitted memorials to the throne, he repeatedly remonstrated to stop the king; the king would not heed him;

sentences.zh: 有畔心，數稱病，不見漢使者。

translations.literal: he had a rebellious heart, repeatedly claimed illness, and would not see Han envoys.
translations.idiomatic: he had a rebellious heart, repeatedly claimed illness, and would not see Han envoys.

sentences.zh: 使者皆注意嘉，勢未能誅。

translations.literal: The envoys all kept their eyes on Jia, but the situation did not allow execution.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys all kept their eyes on Jia, but the situation did not allow execution.

sentences.zh: 王、王太后亦恐嘉等先事發，欲介漢使者權，謀誅嘉等，乃置酒請使者，大臣皆侍坐飲。

translations.literal: The king and Queen Mother also feared Jia and others would act first; wishing to borrow Han envoys' authority, they plotted to execute Jia and others; they then set out wine and invited the envoys, and the great ministers all attended seated and drank.
translations.idiomatic: The king and Queen Mother also feared Jia and others would act first; wishing to borrow Han envoys' authority, they plotted to execute Jia and others; they then set out wine and invited the envoys, and the great ministers all attended seated and drank.

sentences.zh: 嘉弟為將，將卒居宮外。

translations.literal: Jia's younger brother was a general; he led troops dwelling outside the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Jia's younger brother was a general; he led troops dwelling outside the palace.

sentences.zh: 酒行，太后謂嘉曰：「南越內屬，國之利也；

translations.literal: As the wine went round, the Queen Mother said to Jia: "For Nanyue to submit to the interior is the state's advantage;
translations.idiomatic: As the wine went round, the Queen Mother said to Jia, "For Nanyue to submit to the interior is the state's advantage;

sentences.zh: 而相君苦不便者，何也？

translations.literal: yet the Chancellor bitterly finds it inconvenient—why?
translations.idiomatic: yet the Chancellor bitterly finds it inconvenient—why?

sentences.zh: 」以激怒使者，使者狐疑相杖，遂莫敢發。

translations.literal: " thereby to provoke the envoys; the envoys hesitated and leaned on one another, and in the end none dared act.
translations.idiomatic: " thereby to provoke the envoys; the envoys hesitated and leaned on one another, and in the end none dared act.

sentences.zh: 嘉見耳目非是，即起而出。

translations.literal: Jia saw that eyes and ears were not right, immediately rose and went out.
translations.idiomatic: Jia saw that eyes and ears were not right, immediately rose and went out.

sentences.zh: 太后怒，欲鏦嘉以矛，王止太后。

translations.literal: The Queen Mother was angry and wished to stab Jia with a spear; the king stopped the Queen Mother.
translations.idiomatic: The Queen Mother was angry and wished to stab Jia with a spear; the king stopped the Queen Mother.

sentences.zh: 嘉遂出，介其弟兵就舍，稱病，不肯見王及使者，陰與大臣謀作亂。

translations.literal: Jia then went out, borrowed his brother's troops and went to quarters, claimed illness, refused to see the king and envoys, and secretly with the great ministers plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Jia then went out, borrowed his brother's troops and went to quarters, claimed illness, refused to see the king and envoys, and secretly with the great ministers plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 王素無意誅嘉，嘉知之，以故數月不發。

translations.literal: The king from the first had no intent to execute Jia; Jia knew it, and for that reason several months passed without outbreak.
translations.idiomatic: The king from the first had no intent to execute Jia; Jia knew it, and for that reason several months passed without outbreak.

sentences.zh: 天子聞嘉不聽命，王、王太后孤弱不能制，使者怯無決；

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven heard Jia would not heed orders, the king and Queen Mother were isolated and weak and could not control him, the envoys were timid without decision;
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven heard Jia would not heed orders, the king and Queen Mother were isolated and weak and could not control him, and the envoys were timid without decision;

sentences.zh: 又以為王、王太后已附漢，獨呂嘉為亂，不足以興兵，欲使莊參以二千人往使。

translations.literal: he also thought the king and Queen Mother had already attached to Han, and Lu Jia alone was in rebellion—not enough to raise troops—and wished to send Zhuang Can with two thousand men to go as envoys.
translations.idiomatic: he also thought the king and Queen Mother had already attached to Han, and Lu Jia alone was in rebellion—not enough to raise troops—and wished to send Zhuang Can with two thousand men as envoys.

sentences.zh: 參曰：「以好往，數人足矣；

translations.literal: Can said: "If one goes in friendship, a few men suffice;
translations.idiomatic: Can said, "If one goes in friendship, a few men suffice;

sentences.zh: 以武往，二千人無足以為也。

translations.literal: if one goes in force, two thousand men are not enough to accomplish it.
translations.idiomatic: if one goes in force, two thousand men are not enough to accomplish it.

sentences.zh: 」辭不可，天子罷參。

translations.literal: " His plea was not accepted; the Son of Heaven dismissed Can.
translations.idiomatic: " His plea was not accepted; the Son of Heaven dismissed Can.

sentences.zh: 郟壯士故濟北相韓千秋奮曰：「以區區之越，又有王、王太后應，獨相呂嘉為害，願得勇士三百人，必斬嘉以報。

translations.literal: A stalwart of Zheng, former Chancellor of Jibei Han Qianqiu, exclaimed: "For a petty Yue, with the king and Queen Mother responding within, and Chancellor Lu Jia alone doing harm—I wish to have three hundred brave men and will certainly behead Jia in return.
translations.idiomatic: A stalwart of Zheng, former Chancellor of Jibei Han Qianqiu, exclaimed, "For a petty Yue, with the king and Queen Mother responding within, and Chancellor Lu Jia alone doing harm—I wish to have three hundred brave men and will certainly behead Jia in return.

sentences.zh: 」於是天子遣千秋與王太后弟樛樂將二千人往，入越境。

translations.literal: " Thereupon the Son of Heaven dispatched Qianqiu and the Queen Mother's younger brother Jiu Le leading two thousand men to go; they entered Yue territory.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon the Son of Heaven dispatched Qianqiu and the Queen Mother's younger brother Jiu Le leading two thousand men to go; they entered Yue territory.

sentences.zh: 呂嘉等乃遂反，下令國中曰：「王年少。

translations.literal: Lu Jia and others thereupon rebelled and issued orders within the state, saying: "The king is young.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jia and others thereupon rebelled and issued orders within the state, saying, "The king is young.

sentences.zh: 太后，中國人也，又與使者亂，專欲內屬，盡持先王寶器入獻天子以自媚；

translations.literal: The Queen Mother is a man of China, and again with the envoys in disorder, devoted solely to wishing to submit to the interior, entirely taking the former kings' precious vessels to present to the Son of Heaven to flatter herself;
translations.idiomatic: The Queen Mother is a woman of China, and again with the envoys in disorder, devoted solely to wishing to submit to the interior, entirely taking the former kings' precious vessels to present to the Son of Heaven to flatter herself;

sentences.zh: 多從人行，至長安，虜賣以為僮僕；

translations.literal: many followers will go; reaching Chang'an, captives will be sold as servants;
translations.idiomatic: many followers will go; reaching Chang'an, captives will be sold as servants;

sentences.zh: 取自脫一時之利，無顧趙氏社稷、為萬世慮計之意。

translations.literal: taking only to escape present advantage, with no thought for the Zhao clan's altars of soil and grain or planning for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: taking only to escape present advantage, with no thought for the Zhao clan's altars of soil and grain or planning for ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 」乃與其弟將卒攻殺王、王太后及漢使者，遣人告蒼梧秦王及其諸郡縣，立明王長男越妻子術陽侯建德為王。

translations.literal: " He then with his brother led troops to attack and kill the king, Queen Mother, and Han envoys, sent men to inform the King of Cangwu and his various commanderies and counties, and established Ming King's eldest son by his Yue wife, Marquis of Shuyang Jian De, as king.
translations.idiomatic: " He then with his brother led troops to attack and kill the king, Queen Mother, and Han envoys, sent men to inform the King of Cangwu and his various commanderies and counties, and established Ming King's eldest son by his Yue wife, Marquis of Shuyang Jian De, as king.

sentences.zh: 而韓千秋兵入，破數小邑。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Han Qianqiu's troops entered and overthrew several small towns.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Han Qianqiu's troops entered and overthrew several small towns.

sentences.zh: 其後越開直道給食，未至番禺四十里，越以兵擊千秋等，遂滅之；

translations.literal: Afterward Yue opened a direct road to supply food; not yet forty li from Panyu, Yue with troops struck Qianqiu and others and thereupon destroyed them;
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Yue opened a direct road to supply food; not yet forty li from Panyu, Yue with troops struck Qianqiu and others and thereupon destroyed them;

sentences.zh: 使人函封漢使者節置塞上，好為謾辭謝罪，發兵守要害處。

translations.literal: they sent men to seal Han envoys' tallies in a casket and place them on the border, spoke fine deceitful words apologizing, and raised troops to guard strategic points.
translations.idiomatic: they sent men to seal Han envoys' tallies in a casket and place them on the border, spoke fine deceitful words apologizing, and raised troops to guard strategic points.

sentences.zh: 春，三月，壬午，天子聞南越反，曰：「韓千秋雖無功，亦軍鋒之冠，封其子延年為成安侯；

translations.literal: In spring, the third month, on renwu, the Son of Heaven heard Nanyue had rebelled and said: "Han Qianqiu though without achievement was still the crown of the army's spearhead—enfeoff his son Yan Nian as Marquis of Cheng'an;
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the third month, on renwu, the Son of Heaven heard Nanyue had rebelled and said, "Han Qianqiu, though without achievement, was still the crown of the army's spearhead—enfeoff his son Yan Nian as Marquis of Cheng'an;

sentences.zh: 樛樂姊為王太后，首願屬漢，封其子廣德為龍亢侯。

translations.literal: Jiu Le's elder sister was Queen Mother, first willing to submit to Han—enfeoff her son Guang De as Marquis of Longkang.
translations.idiomatic: Jiu Le's elder sister was Queen Mother, first willing to submit to Han—enfeoff her son Guang De as Marquis of Longkang.

sentences.zh: 」----3夏，四月，赦天下。

translations.literal: " ----3 In summer, the fourth month, amnesty for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: " ----3 In summer, the fourth month, there was an amnesty for all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: ----4丁丑晦，日有食之。

translations.literal: ----4 On dingchou, last day of the month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: ----4 On dingchou, last day of the month, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: ----5秋，遣伏波將軍路博德出桂陽，下湟水；

translations.literal: ----5 In autumn he dispatched General Who Calms the Waves Luo Bode out from Guiyang, down the Huang River;
translations.idiomatic: ----5 In autumn he dispatched General Who Calms the Waves Luo Bode out from Guiyang, down the Huang River;

sentences.zh: 樓船將軍楊僕出豫章，下湞水；

translations.literal: Tower Ship General Yang Pu out from Yuzhang, down the Zhen River;
translations.idiomatic: Tower Ship General Yang Pu out from Yuzhang, down the Zhen River;

sentences.zh: 歸義越侯嚴為戈船將軍，出零陵，下離水；

translations.literal: Marquis Yan of the Yue Who Returned to Righteousness as Ge Ship General out from Lingling, down the Li River;
translations.idiomatic: Marquis Yan of the Yue Who Returned to Righteousness as Ge Ship General out from Lingling, down the Li River;

sentences.zh: 甲為下瀨將軍，下蒼梧；

translations.literal: Jia as General of the Lower Rapids down to Cangwu;
translations.idiomatic: Jia as General of the Lower Rapids down to Cangwu;

sentences.zh: 皆將罪人，江、淮以南樓船十萬人。

translations.literal: all leading convicts—one hundred thousand tower-ship men south of the Yangzi and Huai.
translations.idiomatic: all leading convicts—one hundred thousand tower-ship men south of the Yangzi and Huai.

sentences.zh: 越馳義侯遺別將巴、蜀罪人，發夜郎兵，下牂柯江，咸會番禺。

translations.literal: Marquis of the Yue Who Hastened to Righteousness sent a separate commander with Ba and Shu convicts, raised Yelang troops, down the Zangke River—all to assemble at Panyu.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of the Yue Who Hastened to Righteousness sent a separate commander with Ba and Shu convicts, raised Yelang troops, down the Zangke River—all to assemble at Panyu.

sentences.zh: 齊相卜式上書，請父子與齊習船者往死南越。

translations.literal: Chancellor of Qi Bu Shi submitted a memorial requesting that he and his sons, with men of Qi skilled in boats, go to die for the campaign against Nanyue.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor of Qi Bu Shi submitted a memorial requesting that he and his sons, with men of Qi skilled in boats, go to die for the campaign against Nanyue.

sentences.zh: 天子下詔褒美式，賜爵關內侯，金六十斤，田十頃，佈告天下；

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven issued an edict praising Shi's manner, bestowed the rank of Marquis within the Passes, sixty jin of gold, ten qing of fields, and proclaimed it to all under Heaven;
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven issued an edict praising Shi's manner, bestowed the rank of Marquis within the Passes, sixty jin of gold, ten qing of fields, and proclaimed it to all under Heaven;

sentences.zh: 天下莫應。

translations.literal: all under Heaven none responded.
translations.idiomatic: yet all under Heaven none responded.

sentences.zh: 是時列侯以百數，皆莫求從軍擊越。

translations.literal: At this time full marquises numbered in the hundreds, yet none sought to follow the army to strike Yue.
translations.idiomatic: At this time full marquises numbered in the hundreds, yet none sought to follow the army to strike Yue.

sentences.zh: 會九月嘗酎，祭宗廟，列侯以令獻金助祭。

translations.literal: It happened to be the ninth month's tasting of new wine, sacrificing at the ancestral temples; full marquises by order presented gold to assist the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: It happened to be the ninth month's tasting of new wine, sacrificing at the ancestral temples; full marquises by order presented gold to assist the sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 少府省金，金有輕及色惡者，上皆令劾以不敬，奪爵者百六人。

translations.literal: The Privy Treasurer inspected the gold; where gold was light or color foul, the emperor all ordered impeachment for disrespect—one hundred six had their titles taken.
translations.idiomatic: The Privy Treasurer inspected the gold; where gold was light or color foul, the emperor all ordered impeachment for disrespect—one hundred six had their titles taken.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，丞相趙周坐知列侯酎金輕，下獄，自殺。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Chancellor Zhao Zhou, guilty of knowing the full marquises' new-wine gold was light, was imprisoned and killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Chancellor Zhao Zhou, guilty of knowing the full marquises' new-wine gold was light, was imprisoned and killed himself.

sentences.zh: ----6丙申，以御史大夫石慶為丞相，封牧丘侯。

translations.literal: ----6 On bingshen, Grand Counsellor Shi Qing was made Chancellor and enfeoffed as Marquis of Muqiu.
translations.idiomatic: ----6 On bingshen, Grand Counsellor Shi Qing was appointed Chancellor and enfeoffed as Marquis of Muqiu.

sentences.zh: 時國家多事，桑弘羊等致利，王溫舒之屬峻法，而兒寬等推文學，皆為九卿，更進用事。

translations.literal: At this time the state had many affairs; Sang Hongyang and others produced profit, Wang Wenshu and his kind applied harsh law, while Ni Kuan and others promoted literary learning—all were Nine Ministers, advancing in rotation to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the state had many affairs; Sang Hongyang and others produced profit, Wang Wenshu and his kind applied harsh law, while Ni Kuan and others promoted literary learning—all were Nine Ministers, advancing in rotation to handle affairs.

sentences.zh: 事不關決於丞相，丞相慶醇謹而已。

translations.literal: Matters not touching on him were not decided by the Chancellor; Chancellor Qing was pure and cautious, that was all.
translations.idiomatic: Matters not touching on him were not decided by the Chancellor; Chancellor Qing was pure and cautious, that was all.

sentences.zh: ----7五利將軍裝治行，東入海求其師。

translations.literal: ----7 General of the Five Powers prepared travel gear and went east into the sea to seek his master.
translations.idiomatic: ----7 General of the Five Powers prepared travel gear and went east into the sea to seek his master.

sentences.zh: 既而不敢入海，之太山祠。

translations.literal: Afterward he did not dare enter the sea and went to sacrifice at Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward he did not dare enter the sea and went to sacrifice at Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 上使人隨驗，實無所見。

translations.literal: The emperor sent men to follow and verify; in truth nothing was seen.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent men to follow and verify; in truth nothing was seen.

sentences.zh: 五利妄言見其師，其方盡多不售，坐誣罔，腰斬；

translations.literal: The Five Powers falsely said he had seen his master; his methods mostly did not sell; guilty of deception, cut at the waist;
translations.idiomatic: The Five Powers falsely said he had seen his master; his methods mostly did not sell; guilty of deception, he was cut at the waist;

sentences.zh: 樂成侯亦棄市。

translations.literal: Marquis of Lecheng was also executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Lecheng was also executed in the market.

sentences.zh: ----8西羌眾十萬人反，與匈奴通使，攻故安，圍抱罕。

translations.literal: ----8 Western Qiang masses of one hundred thousand rebelled, exchanged envoys with the Xiongnu, attacked Gu'an, and besieged Baohan.
translations.idiomatic: ----8 Western Qiang masses of one hundred thousand rebelled, exchanged envoys with the Xiongnu, attacked Gu'an, and besieged Baohan.

sentences.zh: 匈奴入五原，殺太守。

translations.literal: The Xiongnu entered Wuyuan and killed the Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiongnu entered Wuyuan and killed the Administrator.

sentences.zh: 1冬，發卒十萬人，遣將軍李息、郎中令徐自為征西羌，平之。

translations.literal: 1 In winter he raised one hundred thousand conscripts and dispatched Generals Li Xi and Palace Attendant Xu Ziwei to campaign against the Western Qiang and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: 1 In winter he raised one hundred thousand conscripts and dispatched Generals Li Xi and Palace Attendant Xu Ziwei to campaign against the Western Qiang and pacify them.

sentences.zh: ----2樓船將軍楊僕入越地，先陷尋峽，破石門，挫越鋒，以數萬人待伏波將軍路博德至俱進，樓船居前，至番禺。

translations.literal: ----2 Tower Ship General Yang Pu entered Yue territory, first stormed Xun Gorge, broke Stone Gate, blunted Yue's spearhead, with several tens of thousands awaited General Who Calms the Waves Luo Bode to arrive and advance together; Tower Ship went ahead and reached Panyu.
translations.idiomatic: ----2 Tower Ship General Yang Pu entered Yue territory, first stormed Xun Gorge, broke Stone Gate, blunted Yue's spearhead, and with several tens of thousands awaited General Who Calms the Waves Luo Bode to arrive and advance together; Tower Ship went ahead and reached Panyu.

sentences.zh: 南越王建德、相呂嘉城守。

translations.literal: King of Nanyue Jian De and Chancellor Lu Jia defended the city.
translations.idiomatic: King of Nanyue Jian De and Chancellor Lu Jia defended the city.

sentences.zh: 樓船居東南面，伏波居西北面。

translations.literal: Tower Ship held the southeast face; Who Calms the Waves held the northwest face.
translations.idiomatic: Tower Ship held the southeast face; Who Calms the Waves held the northwest face.

sentences.zh: 會暮，樓船攻敗越人，縱火燒城。

translations.literal: At dusk Tower Ship attacked and defeated the Yue men and set fire burning the city.
translations.idiomatic: At dusk Tower Ship attacked and defeated the Yue men and set fire burning the city.

sentences.zh: 伏波為營，遣使者招降者，賜印綬，復縱令相招。

translations.literal: Who Calms the Waves made camp, sent envoys to summon those who would surrender, bestowed seals and ribbons, and again released them to bid one another surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Who Calms the Waves made camp, sent envoys to summon those who would surrender, bestowed seals and ribbons, and again released them to bid one another surrender.

sentences.zh: 樓船力攻燒敵，驅而入伏波營中。

translations.literal: Tower Ship pressed the attack, burned the enemy, and drove them into Who Calms the Waves' camp.
translations.idiomatic: Tower Ship pressed the attack, burned the enemy, and drove them into Who Calms the Waves' camp.

sentences.zh: 黎旦，城中皆降。

translations.literal: At daybreak all in the city surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: At daybreak all in the city surrendered.

sentences.zh: 建德、嘉已夜亡入海，伏波遣人追之。

translations.literal: Jian De and Jia had by night fled into the sea; Who Calms the Waves sent men to pursue them.
translations.idiomatic: Jian De and Jia had by night fled into the sea; Who Calms the Waves sent men to pursue them.

sentences.zh: 校尉司馬蘇弘得建德，越郎都稽得嘉。

translations.literal: Colonel and Major Su Hong captured Jian De; Yue Gentleman Du Ji captured Jia.
translations.idiomatic: Colonel and Major Su Hong captured Jian De; Yue Gentleman Du Ji captured Jia.

sentences.zh: 戈船、下瀨將軍兵及馳義侯所發夜郎兵未下，南越已平矣。

translations.literal: Ge Ship, General of the Lower Rapids' troops, and the Yelang troops raised by Marquis Who Hastened to Righteousness had not yet come down, yet Nanyue was already pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Ship, General of the Lower Rapids' troops, and the Yelang troops raised by Marquis Who Hastened to Righteousness had not yet come down, yet Nanyue was already pacified.

sentences.zh: 遂以其地為南海、蒼梧、鬱林、合浦、交趾、九真、日南、珠崖、儋耳九郡。

translations.literal: Thereupon its territory was made into nine commanderies: Nanhai, Cangwu, Yulin, Hepu, Jiaozhi, Jiuzhen, Rinan, Zhuya, and Dan'er.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon its territory was made into nine commanderies: Nanhai, Cangwu, Yulin, Hepu, Jiaozhi, Jiuzhen, Rinan, Zhuya, and Dan'er.

sentences.zh: 師還，上益封伏波；

translations.literal: When the army returned, the emperor increased Who Calms the Waves' enfeoffment;
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, the emperor increased Who Calms the Waves' enfeoffment;

sentences.zh: 封樓船為將梁侯，蘇弘為海常侯，都稽為臨蔡侯，及越降將蒼梧王趙光等四人皆為侯。

translations.literal: enfeoffed Tower Ship as Marquis of Jiangliang, Su Hong as Marquis of Haichang, Du Ji as Marquis of Lincai, and the four Yue surrendering generals including King of Cangwu Zhao Guang—all as marquises.
translations.idiomatic: enfeoffed Tower Ship as Marquis of Jiangliang, Su Hong as Marquis of Haichang, Du Ji as Marquis of Lincai, and the four Yue surrendering generals including King of Cangwu Zhao Guang—all as marquises.

sentences.zh: ----3公孫卿候神河南，言見仙人跡緱氏城上。

translations.literal: ----3 Gongsun Qing awaited spirits in Henan and said he had seen immortal traces atop the city of Gou.
translations.idiomatic: ----3 Gongsun Qing awaited spirits in Henan and said he had seen immortal traces atop the city of Gou.

sentences.zh: 春，天子親幸緱氏城視跡，問卿：「得毋效文成、五利乎？

translations.literal: In spring the Son of Heaven personally visited the city of Gou to view the traces and asked Qing: "Might this not imitate Wencheng and the Five Powers?
translations.idiomatic: In spring the Son of Heaven personally visited the city of Gou to view the traces and asked Qing, "Might this not imitate Wencheng and the Five Powers?

sentences.zh: 」卿曰：「仙者非有求人主，人主者求之。

translations.literal: " Qing said: "Immortals do not seek a ruler; it is the ruler who seeks them.
translations.idiomatic: " Qing said, "Immortals do not seek a ruler; it is the ruler who seeks them.

sentences.zh: 其道非寬假，神不來。

translations.literal: Their Way is not broad and indulgent—if it is not, spirits do not come.
translations.idiomatic: Their Way is not broad and indulgent—if it is not, spirits do not come.

sentences.zh: 言神事如迂誕，積以歲月，乃可致也。

translations.literal: To speak of spirit affairs seems roundabout and absurd; accumulated over months and years, only then can they be brought.
translations.idiomatic: To speak of spirit affairs seems roundabout and absurd; accumulated over months and years, only then can they be brought.

sentences.zh: 」上信之。

translations.literal: " The emperor believed him.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor believed him.

sentences.zh: 於是郡、國各除道，繕治宮觀、名山、神祠以望幸焉。

translations.literal: Thereupon each commandery and kingdom cleared roads, repaired palaces and lodges, famous mountains and spirit shrines to look toward imperial visits.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon each commandery and kingdom cleared roads, repaired palaces and lodges, famous mountains and spirit shrines to look toward imperial visits.

sentences.zh: ----4賽南越，祠泰一、-{后土}-，始用樂舞。

translations.literal: ----4 In thanksgiving for Nanyue, he sacrificed to Grand Unity and -{Houtu}-, and for the first time used music and dance.
translations.idiomatic: ----4 In thanksgiving for Nanyue, he sacrificed to Grand Unity and -{Houtu}-, and for the first time used music and dance.

sentences.zh: ----5馳義侯發南夷兵，欲以擊南越。

translations.literal: ----5 Marquis Who Hastened to Righteousness raised Southern Yi troops, intending to use them to strike Nanyue.
translations.idiomatic: ----5 Marquis Who Hastened to Righteousness raised Southern Yi troops, intending to use them to strike Nanyue.

sentences.zh: 且蘭君恐遠行旁國，虜其老弱，乃與其眾反，殺使者及犍為太守。

translations.literal: Lord Qielan feared a distant march past neighboring states would capture his old and weak; he then with his masses rebelled and killed the envoy and the Administrator of Qianwei.
translations.idiomatic: Lord Qielan feared a distant march past neighboring states would capture his old and weak; he then with his masses rebelled and killed the envoy and the Administrator of Qianwei.

sentences.zh: 漢乃發巴、蜀罪人當擊南越者八校尉，遣中郎將郭昌、衛廣將而擊之，誅且蘭及邛君、莋侯，遂平南夷為牂柯郡。

translations.literal: Han then raised the Ba and Shu convicts who were to strike Nanyue as eight colonels, dispatched Gentlemen-of-the-Palace Guo Chang and Wei Guang to lead them and strike, executed Qielan and the Lord of Qiong and Marquis of Zhuo, and thereupon pacified the Southern Yi and made them the commandery of Zangke.
translations.idiomatic: Han then raised the Ba and Shu convicts who were to strike Nanyue as eight colonels, dispatched Gentlemen-of-the-Palace Guo Chang and Wei Guang to lead them and strike, executed Qielan and the Lord of Qiong and Marquis of Zhuo, and thereupon pacified the Southern Yi and made them the commandery of Zangke.

sentences.zh: 夜郎侯始倚南越，南越已滅，夜郎遂入朝，上以為夜郎王。

translations.literal: The Marquis of Yelang at first relied on Nanyue; Nanyue having already been destroyed, Yelang thereupon entered court, and the emperor made him King of Yelang.
translations.idiomatic: The Marquis of Yelang had at first relied on Nanyue; after Nanyue was destroyed, Yelang came to court, and the emperor made him King of Yelang.

sentences.zh: 冉駹皆振恐，清臣置吏，乃以邛都為越巂郡，莋都為沈黎郡，冉駹為汶山郡，廣漢西白馬為武都郡。

translations.literal: The Ran and Qiang were all shaken with fear; the court cleared and set officials, and thereupon made Qiongdu into Yuexi commandery, Zhuodu into Shenli commandery, Ran and Qiang into Wenshan commandery, and the white-horse people west of Guanghan into Wudong commandery.
translations.idiomatic: The Ran and Qiang were all shaken with fear; the court cleared the region and set officials, making Qiongdu into Yuexi commandery, Zhuodu into Shenli commandery, the Ran and Qiang into Wenshan commandery, and the white-horse people west of Guanghan into Wudong commandery.

sentences.zh: ----6初，東越王餘善上書，請以卒八千人從樓船擊呂嘉；

translations.literal: ----6 Initially, the King of Eastern Yue Yu Shan memorialized, requesting to lead eight thousand soldiers to follow the Tower Ship army in attacking Lü Jia;
translations.idiomatic: ----6 Initially the King of Eastern Yue, Yu Shan, memorialized, asking to lead eight thousand soldiers to follow the Tower Ship army in attacking Lü Jia;

sentences.zh: 兵至揭揚，以海風波為解，不行，持兩端，陰使南越。

translations.literal: when the troops reached Jieyang, he used sea winds and waves as his excuse and did not advance, held to both sides, and secretly sent envoys to Nanyue.
translations.idiomatic: when the troops reached Jieyang, he used sea winds and waves as an excuse not to advance, hedged between both sides, and secretly sent envoys to Nanyue.

sentences.zh: 及漢破番禺，不至。

translations.literal: When Han broke Panyu, he did not arrive.
translations.idiomatic: When Han took Panyu, he did not arrive.

sentences.zh: 楊僕上書願便引兵擊東越；

translations.literal: Yang Pu memorialized, wishing to lead troops at once to attack Eastern Yue;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Pu memorialized, asking to lead troops at once against Eastern Yue;

sentences.zh: 上以士卒勞倦，不許，令諸校屯豫章、梅嶺以待命。

translations.literal: the emperor, because the soldiers were weary from toil, did not permit it and ordered the various colonels to garrison at Yuzhang and Meiling to await orders.
translations.idiomatic: the emperor, because the troops were weary, refused and ordered the colonels to garrison at Yuzhang and Meiling to await orders.

sentences.zh: 餘善聞樓船請誅之，漢兵臨境，乃遂反，發兵距漢道，號將軍騶力等為吞漢將軍，入白沙、武林、梅嶺，殺漢三校尉。

translations.literal: Yu Shan heard the Tower Ship army had requested his execution and Han troops were at the border; he thereupon rebelled, raised troops to block Han's routes, styled General Zou Li and others as Swallow-Han Generals, entered Baisha, Wulin, and Meiling, and killed three Han colonels.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Shan heard that the Tower Ship army had asked for his execution and that Han troops were at the border; he thereupon rebelled, raised troops to block Han routes, styled General Zou Li and others Swallow-Han Generals, entered Baisha, Wulin, and Meiling, and killed three Han colonels.

sentences.zh: 是時，漢使大農張成、故山州侯齒將屯，弗敢擊，卻就便處，皆坐畏懦誅。

translations.literal: At this time Han envoys Grand Minister of Agriculture Zhang Cheng and the former Marquis of Shanzhou Chi led garrisons but dared not attack, withdrew to convenient positions, and all were punished for cowardice and executed.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the Han envoys Grand Minister of Agriculture Zhang Cheng and the former Marquis of Shanzhou Chi led garrisons but dared not attack, withdrew to safer positions, and all were executed for cowardice.

sentences.zh: 餘善自稱武帝。

translations.literal: Yu Shan styled himself Martial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Shan styled himself Martial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 上欲復使楊僕將，為其伐前勞，以書敕責之曰：「將軍之功獨有先破石門、尋陿，非有斬將搴旗之實也，烏足以驕人哉！

translations.literal: The emperor wished again to have Yang Pu command; because of his earlier merit in the campaign, he sent a letter rebuking him, saying: "The general's achievement lies solely in having first broken Shimen and Xunyang—there was no reality of beheading generals and seizing banners; how is that enough to make one proud before others!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished again to have Yang Pu command; because of his earlier merit in the campaign, he sent a letter rebuking him, saying, "Your achievement lies solely in having first broken Shimen and Xunyang—there was no beheading of generals or seizing of banners; how is that enough to make you proud before others!

sentences.zh: 前破番禺，捕降者以為虜，掘死人以為獲，是一過也；

translations.literal: Earlier when you broke Panyu, you treated captured surrenderers as captives and dug up the dead and counted them as trophies—this is the first fault;
translations.idiomatic: When you took Panyu earlier, you treated surrendered captives as booty and dug up the dead and counted them as trophies—this is the first fault;

sentences.zh: 使建德、呂嘉得以東越為援，是二過也；

translations.literal: you let Jiande and Lü Jia obtain Eastern Yue as support—this is the second fault;
translations.idiomatic: you let Jiande and Lü Jia obtain Eastern Yue as support—this is the second fault;

sentences.zh: 士卒暴露連歲，將軍不念其勤勞，而請乘傳行塞，因用歸家，懷銀、黃，垂三組，誇鄉里，是三過也；

translations.literal: soldiers have been exposed in the elements for successive years, yet the general does not think of their toil but requests to ride post relays to the frontier passes and thereby use the occasion to return home, bearing silver and gold seals, with three ribbon-groups hanging down, boasting to his home district—this is the third fault;
translations.idiomatic: your soldiers have been exposed in the elements for years, yet you do not think of their toil but asked to ride post relays to the frontier and thereby return home, bearing silver and gold seals with three ribbon-groups hanging down, boasting in your home district—this is the third fault;

sentences.zh: 失期內顧，以道惡為解，是四過也；

translations.literal: you missed the deadline and looked homeward within, using bad roads as your excuse—this is the fourth fault;
translations.idiomatic: you missed the deadline and looked homeward, using bad roads as your excuse—this is the fourth fault;

sentences.zh: 問君蜀刀價而陽不知，挾偽干君，是五過也。

translations.literal: when asked the price of Shu blades you pretended not to know, carrying falsehood to impose on your lord—this is the fifth fault.
translations.idiomatic: when asked the price of Shu blades you pretended not to know, carrying falsehood to impose on your lord—this is the fifth fault.

sentences.zh: 受詔不至蘭池，明日又不對。

translations.literal: You received the edict yet did not come to Lanchi Pool; the next day you again did not respond.
translations.idiomatic: You received the edict yet did not come to Lanchi Pool; the next day you again did not respond.

sentences.zh: 假令將軍之吏，問之不對，令之不從，其罪何如？

translations.literal: Suppose the general's clerks—when questioned they do not answer, when ordered they do not obey—what would their crime be like?
translations.idiomatic: Suppose your clerks, when questioned, do not answer, and when ordered, do not obey—what would their crime be?

sentences.zh: 推此心在外，江海之間可得信乎？

translations.literal: Extend this mind outward—between rivers and seas can one be trusted?
translations.idiomatic: Extend this mind outward—between rivers and seas, can one be trusted?

sentences.zh: 今東越深入，將軍能率眾以掩過不？

translations.literal: Now Eastern Yue has penetrated deep; can the general lead the masses to cover over his faults?
translations.idiomatic: Now Eastern Yue has penetrated deep; can you lead your troops to atone for your faults?

sentences.zh: 」僕惶恐對曰：「願盡死贖罪！

translations.literal: " Pu in fear replied, saying: "Your servant wishes to exhaust his life to redeem his crimes!
translations.idiomatic: " Pu replied in fear, "Your servant wishes to give his life to redeem his crimes!

sentences.zh: 」上乃遣橫海將軍韓說出句章，浮海從東方往；

translations.literal: " The emperor thereupon sent Cross-Sea General Han Shuo out from Gouzhang, crossing the sea from the east;
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor thereupon sent Cross-Sea General Han Shuo out from Gouzhang, crossing the sea from the east;

sentences.zh: 樓船將軍楊僕出武林，中尉王溫舒出梅嶺，以越侯為戈船、下瀨將軍，出若邪、白沙，以擊東越。

translations.literal: Tower Ship General Yang Pu went out from Wulin, Commandant of the Guards Wang Wenshu from Meiling, and the Yue marquis as Ge Ship and Lower Rapids generals from Ruoye and Baisha—to attack Eastern Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Tower Ship General Yang Pu went out from Wulin, Commandant of the Guards Wang Wenshu from Meiling, and the Yue marquis as Ge Ship and Lower Rapids generals from Ruoye and Baisha to attack Eastern Yue.

sentences.zh: ----7博望侯既以通西域尊貴，其吏士爭上書言外國奇怪利害求使。

translations.literal: ----7 The Marquis of Bowang, having become honored for opening the Western Regions, had his clerks and soldiers compete in memorializing about foreign lands' wonders, oddities, profits, and harms, seeking missions.
translations.idiomatic: ----7 The Marquis of Bowang, having become honored for opening the Western Regions, had his clerks and soldiers compete in memorializing about foreign wonders, profits, and harms, seeking missions.

sentences.zh: 天子為其絕遠，非人所樂往，聽其言，予節，募吏民，毋問所從來，為具備人眾遣之，以廣其道。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven, because the route was extremely remote and not what men delighted to go to, listened to their words, granted credentials, recruited officials and people without asking where they came from, equipped them with men and masses and sent them off, to broaden the route.
translations.idiomatic: Because the route was extremely remote and not what men delighted to travel, the emperor listened to their words, granted credentials, recruited officials and people without asking where they came from, equipped them with supplies and sent them off to broaden the route.

sentences.zh: 來還，不能毋侵盜幣物及使失指，天子為其習之，輒覆按致重罪，以激怒令贖，復求使，使端無窮，而輕犯法。

translations.literal: When they returned, they could not but rob goods and miss their instructions; the Son of Heaven, because they were accustomed to this, would investigate and impose heavy crimes, provoking them to anger so they would ransom themselves and again seek missions—envoys without end, yet lightly breaking the law.
translations.idiomatic: When they returned, they inevitably robbed goods and missed their instructions; because they were accustomed to this, the emperor would investigate and impose heavy crimes, provoking them to ransom themselves and again seek missions—envoys without end, yet lightly breaking the law.

sentences.zh: 其吏卒亦輒復盛推外國所有，言大者予節，言小者為副，故妄言無行之徒皆爭效之。

translations.literal: Their clerks and soldiers also repeatedly exaggerated what foreign states possessed; those who spoke grandly received credentials, those who spoke smallly became deputies—therefore reckless speakers without conduct all competed to imitate them.
translations.idiomatic: Their clerks and soldiers also repeatedly exaggerated what foreign states possessed; those who spoke grandly received credentials, those who spoke modestly became deputies—therefore reckless speakers without conduct all competed to imitate them.

sentences.zh: 其使皆貧人子，私縣官賫物，欲賤市以私其利。

translations.literal: Their envoys were all sons of poor men who privately attached government gifts, wishing to buy cheaply for private profit.
translations.idiomatic: Their envoys were all sons of poor men who privately took government gifts, wishing to buy cheaply for private profit.

sentences.zh: 外國亦厭漢使，人人有言輕重，度漢兵遠不能至，而禁其食物以苦漢使。

translations.literal: Foreign states also grew weary of Han envoys; each man had words of weight and lightness, judging Han troops could not arrive from afar, and forbade their food to distress Han envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign states also grew weary of Han envoys; each judged Han troops could not arrive from afar and forbade food to distress the Han envoys.

sentences.zh: 漢使乏絕，積怨至相攻擊。

translations.literal: Han envoys were exhausted and cut off; accumulated resentment reached mutual attack.
translations.idiomatic: Han envoys were exhausted and cut off; accumulated resentment led to mutual attacks.

sentences.zh: 而樓蘭、車師，小國當空道，攻漢使王恢等尤甚，而匈奴奇兵又時遮擊之。

translations.literal: Moreover Loulan and Cheshi, small states blocking the empty route, attacked Han envoys such as Wang Hui especially severely, and Xiongnu picked troops also sometimes intercepted and struck them.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Loulan and Cheshi, small states blocking the route, attacked Han envoys such as Wang Hui especially severely, and Xiongnu picked troops also sometimes intercepted them.

sentences.zh: 使者爭言西域皆有城邑，兵弱易擊。

translations.literal: Envoys competed in saying the Western Regions all had walled towns, troops weak and easy to strike.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys competed in saying the Western Regions all had walled towns with weak troops easy to strike.

sentences.zh: 於是天子遣浮沮將軍公孫賀將萬五千騎，出九原二千餘里，至浮沮井而還；

translations.literal: Thereupon the Son of Heaven sent Floating Quagmire General Gongsun He to lead fifteen thousand horsemen, going out from Jiuyuan more than two thousand li to Floating Quagmire Well and returning;
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the emperor sent Floating Quagmire General Gongsun He to lead fifteen thousand horsemen out from Jiuyuan more than two thousand li to Floating Quagmire Well and back;

sentences.zh: 匈河將軍趙破奴將萬餘騎出令居數千里，至匈河水而還；

translations.literal: Hun River General Zhao Ponu led more than ten thousand horsemen out from Lingju several thousand li to the Hun River and returned;
translations.idiomatic: Hun River General Zhao Ponu led more than ten thousand horsemen out from Lingju several thousand li to the Hun River and back;

sentences.zh: 以斥逐匈奴，不使遮漢使，皆不見匈奴一人。

translations.literal: to drive off and expel the Xiongnu and not let them intercept Han envoys—yet none saw a single Xiongnu man.
translations.idiomatic: to drive off the Xiongnu and keep them from intercepting Han envoys—yet none saw a single Xiongnu.

sentences.zh: 乃分武威、酒泉地置張掖、敦煌郡，徙民以實之。

translations.literal: Thereupon they divided the lands of Wuwei and Jiuquan to establish Zhangye and Dunhuang commanderies and moved people to fill them.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon they divided the lands of Wuwei and Jiuquan to establish Zhangye and Dunhuang commanderies and moved people to settle them.

sentences.zh: ----8是歲，齊相卜式為御史大夫。

translations.literal: ----8 This year, Qi Chancellor Bu Shi became Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: ----8 This year Qi Chancellor Bu Shi became Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 式既在位，乃言：「郡、國多不便縣官作鹽鐵器，苦惡價貴，或強令民買之；

translations.literal: Shi having taken office, then said: "In the commanderies and kingdoms it is mostly inconvenient that the county officials make salt and iron tools—bitter, bad, and costly—or they forcibly order the people to buy them;
translations.idiomatic: Once in office, Shi said, "In the commanderies and kingdoms it is mostly inconvenient that the government makes salt and iron goods—poor in quality and costly—or forcibly orders the people to buy them;

sentences.zh: 而船有算，商者少，物貴。

translations.literal: moreover ships have levies, merchants are few, and goods are costly.
translations.idiomatic: moreover ships are taxed, merchants are few, and goods are costly.

sentences.zh: 」上由是不悅卜式。

translations.literal: " The emperor thereby was displeased with Bu Shi.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor thereby was displeased with Bu Shi.

sentences.zh: ----9初，司馬相如病且死，有遺書，頌功德，言符瑞，勸上封泰山。

translations.literal: ----9 Initially, Sima Xiangru was ill and near death; he left a testament praising merit and virtue, speaking of omens and auspicious signs, and urging the emperor to perform the feng and shan rites on Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: ----9 Initially Sima Xiangru was ill and near death; he left a testament praising merit and virtue, speaking of omens and auspicious signs, and urging the emperor to perform the feng and shan rites on Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 上感其言，會得寶鼎，上乃與公卿諸生議封禪。

translations.literal: The emperor was moved by his words; it happened that a precious tripod was obtained, and the emperor thereupon deliberated on feng and shan with the dukes, ministers, and scholars.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was moved by his words; when a precious tripod was obtained, he deliberated on feng and shan with the dukes, ministers, and scholars.

sentences.zh: 封禪用希曠絕，莫知其儀，而諸方士又言：「封禪者合不死之名也，黃帝以上，封禪皆致怪物，與神通，秦皇帝不得上封。

translations.literal: Feng and shan were used rarely, vast and cut off; none knew their ritual. Moreover the various masters of the methods said: "Feng and shan combine the name of not dying; from the Yellow Emperor upward, feng and shan all brought forth strange creatures and communicated with spirits. The First Emperor of Qin could not ascend to perform the feng.
translations.idiomatic: Feng and shan were used rarely and were vast in scope; none knew their ritual. Moreover the masters of the methods said, "Feng and shan combine the name of immortality; from the Yellow Emperor upward, feng and shan all brought forth strange creatures and communion with spirits. The First Emperor of Qin could not ascend to perform the feng.

sentences.zh: 陛下必欲上，稍上即無風雨，遂上封矣。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty must wish to ascend, as you ascend slightly there will be no wind or rain, and then you may ascend to perform the feng.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty must ascend, as you ascend slightly there will be no wind or rain, and then you may ascend to perform the feng.

sentences.zh: 」上於是乃令諸儒采《尚書》、《周官》、《王制》之文，草封禪儀，數年不成。

translations.literal: " The emperor thereupon ordered the various Ru to gather passages from the Documents, the Offices of Zhou, and the Royal Regulations to draft feng and shan ritual—several years without completion.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor thereupon ordered the Ru to gather passages from the Documents, the Offices of Zhou, and the Royal Regulations to draft feng and shan ritual—several years passed without completion.

sentences.zh: 上以問左內史兒寬，寬曰：「封泰山，禪梁父，昭姓考瑞，帝王之盛節也；

translations.literal: The emperor asked Left Interior Minister Er Kuan; Kuan said: "Feng on Mount Tai and shan at Liangfu display the surname and examine auspicious omens—it is the grand ceremony of emperors and kings;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked Left Interior Minister Er Kuan; Kuan said, "Feng on Mount Tai and shan at Liangfu display the surname and examine auspicious omens—it is the grand ceremony of emperors and kings;

sentences.zh: 然享薦之義，不著於《經》。

translations.literal: yet the meaning of offering and presenting is not set forth in the Classics.
translations.idiomatic: yet the meaning of offering and presenting is not set forth in the Classics.

sentences.zh: 臣以為封禪告成，合祛於天地神衹，唯聖主所由，制定其當，非群臣之所能列。

translations.literal: Your servant thinks that when feng and shan announce completion, the union of prayer to Heaven and Earth and the spirits and gods depends solely on what the sage ruler follows—he fixes what is fitting; it is not what the ministers can enumerate.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant thinks that when feng and shan announce completion, the union of prayer to Heaven, Earth, and the spirits depends solely on what the sage ruler follows—he fixes what is fitting; it is not what ministers can enumerate.

sentences.zh: 今將舉大事，優遊數年，使群臣得人人自盡，終莫能成。

translations.literal: Now you are about to undertake a great affair yet linger at ease for several years, letting the ministers each exhaust himself—yet in the end none can complete it.
translations.idiomatic: Now you are about to undertake a great affair yet linger at ease for several years, letting the ministers each exhaust himself—yet in the end none can complete it.

sentences.zh: 唯天子建中和之極，兼總條貫，金聲而玉振之，以順成天慶，垂萬世之基。

translations.literal: Only the Son of Heaven establishes the utmost of central harmony, gathers and threads all together, sounds gold and vibrates jade, to accord with and complete Heaven's celebration, and hand down the foundation for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Son of Heaven establishes the utmost of central harmony, gathers and threads all together, sounds gold and vibrates jade, to accord with Heaven's celebration and hand down the foundation for ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 」上乃自製儀，頗采儒術以文之。

translations.literal: " The emperor thereupon himself fashioned the ritual, largely adopting Ru techniques to adorn it.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor thereupon himself fashioned the ritual, largely adopting Ru techniques to adorn it.

sentences.zh: 上為封禪祠器，以示群儒，或曰「不與古同」，於是盡罷諸儒不用。

translations.literal: The emperor made feng and shan sacrificial vessels and showed them to the Ru masses; some said "they do not match antiquity," and thereupon he completely dismissed all the Ru and did not use them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor made feng and shan sacrificial vessels and showed them to the Ru; some said they did not match antiquity, and thereupon he completely dismissed all the Ru and did not use them.

sentences.zh: 上又以古者先振兵釋旅，然後封禪。

translations.literal: The emperor also thought that in antiquity one first shook the troops and released the hosts, and only then performed feng and shan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also thought that in antiquity one first reviewed the troops and released the hosts, and only then performed feng and shan.

sentences.zh: 1冬，十月，下詔曰：「南越、東甌，鹹伏其辜；

translations.literal: 1 In winter, the tenth month, an edict was issued, saying: "Nanyue and Eastern Ou have all submitted to their guilt;
translations.idiomatic: 1 In winter, the tenth month, an edict was issued, saying, "Nanyue and Eastern Ou have all submitted to their guilt;

sentences.zh: 西蠻、北夷，頗未輯睦；

translations.literal: the western barbarians and northern Yi are mostly not yet gathered in harmony;
translations.idiomatic: the western barbarians and northern Yi are mostly not yet gathered in harmony;

sentences.zh: 朕將巡邊垂，躬秉武節，置十二部將軍，親帥師焉。

translations.literal: We shall tour the border marches, personally grasp the martial baton, establish twelve-section generals, and personally lead the army."
translations.idiomatic: We shall tour the border marches, personally grasp the martial baton, establish twelve-section generals, and personally lead the army."

sentences.zh: 」乃行，自雲陽北歷上郡、西河、五原，出長城，北登單于台，至朔方，臨北河，遣使者郭吉告單于曰：「南越王頭已縣於漢北闕。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he set out, from Yunyang north through Shang commandery, Xihe, and Wuyuan, out through the Long Wall, north ascending Chanyu Terrace, reaching Shuofang, facing the Northern River, and sent envoy Guo Ji to tell the chanyu: "The King of Nanyue's head is already hung at Han's northern gate.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon he set out from Yunyang north through Shang commandery, Xihe, and Wuyuan, out through the Long Wall, north ascending Chanyu Terrace to Shuofang, facing the Northern River, and sent envoy Guo Ji to tell the chanyu, "The King of Nanyue's head is already hung at Han's northern gate.

sentences.zh: 今單于能戰，天子自將待邊；

translations.literal: Now if the chanyu can fight, the Son of Heaven will himself lead troops and wait at the border;
translations.idiomatic: Now if the chanyu can fight, the emperor will himself lead troops and wait at the border;

sentences.zh: 不能，即南面而臣於漢，何徒遠走亡匿於幕北寒苦無水草之地！

translations.literal: if you cannot, then at once turn south and become a subject of Han—why vainly flee far and hide in the cold, bitter, waterless and grassless lands north of the desert screen!
translations.idiomatic: if you cannot, then at once turn south and become a subject of Han—why vainly flee far and hide in the cold, bitter, waterless and grassless lands north of the desert!

sentences.zh: 毋為也。

translations.literal: Do not do it.
translations.idiomatic: Do not do it.

sentences.zh: 語卒而單于大怒，立斬主客見者，而留郭吉，遷之北海上。

translations.literal: As the words ended the chanyu was greatly enraged, immediately beheaded the chief guest who had seen him, detained Guo Ji, and moved him to the northern sea frontier.
translations.idiomatic: As the words ended the chanyu was greatly enraged, immediately beheaded the chief guest who had received him, detained Guo Ji, and moved him to the northern sea frontier.

sentences.zh: 然匈奴亦讋，終不敢出。

translations.literal: Yet the Xiongnu were also fearful and in the end dared not come out.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Xiongnu were also fearful and in the end dared not come out.

sentences.zh: 上乃還，祭黃帝塚橋山，釋兵須如。

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon returned, sacrificed at the Yellow Emperor's tomb on Bridge Mountain, and released the troops at Xuru.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thereupon returned, sacrificed at the Yellow Emperor's tomb on Bridge Mountain, and released the troops at Xuru.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「吾聞黃帝不死，今有塚，何也？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "We have heard the Yellow Emperor did not die—now there is a tomb; why is that?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "We have heard the Yellow Emperor did not die—now there is a tomb; why is that?

sentences.zh: 」公孫卿曰：「黃帝已仙上天，群臣思慕，葬其衣冠。

translations.literal: " Gongsun Qing said: "The Yellow Emperor had already ascended as an immortal to Heaven; the ministers thought longingly of him and buried his hat and robes.
translations.idiomatic: " Gongsun Qing said, "The Yellow Emperor had already ascended as an immortal to Heaven; the ministers longed for him and buried his hat and robes.

sentences.zh: 」上歎曰：「吾後升天，群臣亦當葬吾衣冠於東陵乎？

translations.literal: " The emperor sighed and said: "When We later ascend to Heaven, should the ministers also bury Our hat and robes at Eastern Mound?
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor sighed and said, "When I later ascend to Heaven, should the ministers also bury my hat and robes at Eastern Mound?

sentences.zh: 」乃還甘泉，類祠太一。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he returned to Sweet Springs and performed a categorized sacrifice to the Grand Unity.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon he returned to Sweet Springs and performed a categorized sacrifice to the Grand Unity.

sentences.zh: ----2上以卜式不習文章，貶秩為太子太傅，以兒寬代為御史大夫。

translations.literal: ----2 The emperor, because Bu Shi was not practiced in literary composition, demoted his rank to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and had Er Kuan replace him as Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: ----2 Because Bu Shi was not practiced in literary composition, the emperor demoted him to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and had Er Kuan replace him as Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: ----3漢兵入東越境，東越素發兵距險，使徇北將軍守武林。

translations.literal: ----3 Han troops entered Eastern Yue territory; Eastern Yue had always raised troops to hold dangerous passes and sent the Patrol-North General to guard Wulin.
translations.idiomatic: ----3 Han troops entered Eastern Yue territory; Eastern Yue had always raised troops to hold dangerous passes and sent the Patrol-North General to guard Wulin.

sentences.zh: 樓船將軍卒錢塘轅終古斬徇北將軍。

translations.literal: A Tower Ship army soldier from Qiantang, Yuan Zhonggu, beheaded the Patrol-North General.
translations.idiomatic: A Tower Ship army soldier from Qiantang, Yuan Zhonggu, beheaded the Patrol-North General.

sentences.zh: 故越衍侯吳陽以其邑七百人反攻越軍於漢陽。

translations.literal: The former Yue Marquis of Yan Wu Yang with seven hundred men from his town counterattacked Yue troops at Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: The former Yue Marquis of Yan Wu Yang with seven hundred men from his town counterattacked Yue troops at Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 越建成侯敖與繇王居股殺餘善，以其眾降。

translations.literal: Yue Marquis of Jiancheng Ao and the Yao King Ju Gu killed Yu Shan and with their masses surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Marquis of Jiancheng Ao and the Yao King Ju Gu killed Yu Shan and surrendered with their forces.

sentences.zh: 上封終古為御兒侯，陽為卯石侯，居股為東成侯，敖為開陵侯；

translations.literal: The emperor enfeoffed Zhonggu as Marquis of Yu'er, Yang as Marquis of Maoshi, Ju Gu as Marquis of Dongcheng, and Ao as Marquis of Kailing;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor enfeoffed Zhonggu as Marquis of Yu'er, Yang as Marquis of Maoshi, Ju Gu as Marquis of Dongcheng, and Ao as Marquis of Kailing;

sentences.zh: 又封橫海將軍說為按道侯，橫海校尉福為繚嫈侯，東越降將多軍為無錫侯。

translations.literal: moreover he enfeoffed Cross-Sea General Shuo as Marquis of Andao, Cross-Sea Colonel Fu as Marquis of Liaoying, and the Eastern Yue surrendering general Duojun as Marquis of Wuxi.
translations.idiomatic: moreover he enfeoffed Cross-Sea General Shuo as Marquis of Andao, Cross-Sea Colonel Fu as Marquis of Liaoying, and the Eastern Yue surrendering general Duojun as Marquis of Wuxi.

sentences.zh: 上以閩地險阻，數反覆，終為後世患，乃詔諸將悉徙其民於江、淮之間，遂虛其地。

translations.literal: The emperor, because Min territory was dangerous and obstructed and had repeatedly turned back and forth, would in the end become a trouble for later generations; he thereupon ordered the generals to move all its people between the Yangtze and Huai, and thereby emptied the land.
translations.idiomatic: Because Min territory was rugged and had repeatedly rebelled, becoming a trouble for later generations, he ordered the generals to move all its people between the Yangtze and Huai and thereby emptied the land.

sentences.zh: ----4春，正月，上行幸緱氏，禮祭中岳太室，從官在山下聞若有言「萬歲」者三。

translations.literal: ----4 In spring, the first month, the emperor traveled in favor to Goushi and performed rites sacrificing to the Central Peak Grand Chamber; attendants below the mountain heard as if someone said "Long live [the emperor]" three times.
translations.idiomatic: ----4 In spring, the first month, the emperor traveled to Goushi and performed rites sacrificing to the Central Peak Grand Chamber; attendants below the mountain heard as if someone said "Long live the emperor" three times.

sentences.zh: 詔祠官加增太室祠，禁無伐其草木，以山下戶三百為之奉邑。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the sacrificial officials to add to the Grand Chamber shrine, forbade cutting its trees and plants, and made three hundred households below the mountain its sustaining fief.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the sacrificial officials to enlarge the Grand Chamber shrine, forbade cutting its trees and plants, and made three hundred households below the mountain its sustaining fief.

sentences.zh: 上遂東巡海上，行禮祠八神。

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon toured east along the sea, performing rites and sacrificing to the Eight Spirits.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thereupon toured east along the sea, performing rites and sacrificing to the Eight Spirits.

sentences.zh: 齊人之上疏言神怪、奇方者以萬數，乃益發船，令言海中神山者數千人求蓬萊神人。

translations.literal: Qi people who memorialized speaking of spirits, wonders, and strange formulas numbered in the tens of thousands; he thereupon increased dispatched ships and ordered several thousand men who spoke of divine mountains in the sea to seek the Penglai spirit men.
translations.idiomatic: Qi people who memorialized about spirits, wonders, and strange formulas numbered in the tens of thousands; he increased dispatched ships and ordered several thousand men who spoke of divine mountains in the sea to seek the Penglai immortals.

sentences.zh: 公孫卿持節常先行，候名山，至東萊，言：「夜見大人，長數丈，就之則不見，其跡甚大，類禽獸雲。

translations.literal: Gongsun Qing, holding credentials, always went ahead first, watching famous mountains; reaching Donglai he said: "At night I saw a great man several zhang tall; when I approached he could not be seen; his tracks were very large, like birds, beasts, and clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Gongsun Qing, holding credentials, always went ahead first, watching famous mountains; reaching Donglai he said, "At night I saw a great man several zhang tall; when I approached he could not be seen; his tracks were very large, like birds, beasts, and clouds.

sentences.zh: 」群臣有言：「見一老父牽狗，言『吾欲見巨公』，已忽不見。

translations.literal: " Some among the ministers said: "I saw an old man leading a dog who said, 'I wish to see the Great Lord,' and then suddenly he was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: " Some among the ministers said, "I saw an old man leading a dog who said, 'I wish to see the Great Lord,' and then suddenly he was not seen.

sentences.zh: 」上既見大跡，未信，及群臣又言老父，則大以為仙人也，宿留海上；

translations.literal: " The emperor, having already seen the great tracks, did not yet believe; when the ministers also spoke of the old man, he then greatly thought them immortals and lodged on the seacoast;
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor, having already seen the great tracks, did not yet believe; when the ministers also spoke of the old man, he then greatly thought them immortals and lodged on the seacoast;

sentences.zh: 與方士傳車及間使求神仙，人以千數。

translations.literal: with masters of the methods in relay carriages and secret envoys seeking immortals—people by the thousands.
translations.idiomatic: with masters of the methods in relay carriages and secret envoys seeking immortals—people by the thousands.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，還，至奉高，禮祠地主於梁父。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, he returned, reaching Fenggao, and performed rites sacrificing to the Earth Lord at Liangfu.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, he returned to Fenggao and performed rites sacrificing to the Earth Lord at Liangfu.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，令侍中儒者皮弁、搢紳，射牛行事，封泰山下東方，如郊祠泰一之禮。

translations.literal: On yimao, he ordered Palace Attendants and Ru in leather caps and sashes to shoot the ox and perform the rite, performing the feng below Mount Tai on the east, like the suburban sacrifice to the Grand Unity.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, he ordered Palace Attendants and Ru in leather caps and sashes to shoot the ox and perform the rite, performing the feng below Mount Tai on the east, like the suburban sacrifice to the Grand Unity.

sentences.zh: 封廣丈二尺，高九尺，其下則有玉牒書，書秘。

translations.literal: The feng mound was two zhang wide, nine zhang high; beneath it was a jade document—the writing secret.
translations.idiomatic: The feng mound was two zhang wide and nine zhang high; beneath it was a jade document with secret writing.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，天子獨與侍中、奉車都尉霍子侯上泰山，亦有封，其事皆禁。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, the Son of Heaven alone with the Palace Attendant and Chief of the Imperial Carriages Huo Zihou ascended Mount Tai; there was also a feng; all the matters were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was complete, the emperor alone with the Palace Attendant and Chief of the Imperial Carriages Huo Zihou ascended Mount Tai; there was also a feng; all the matters were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 明日，下陰道。

translations.literal: The next day he descended by the shaded path.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he descended by the shaded path.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，禪泰山下阯東北肅然山，如祭-{后土}-禮，天子皆親拜見，衣上黃，而盡用樂焉。

translations.literal: On bingchen he performed the shan at Mount Suiran northeast of the foot of Mount Tai, like the sacrifice to -{后土}-; the Son of Heaven all personally bowed and met, wore upper yellow, and used music throughout.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he performed the shan at Mount Suiran northeast of the foot of Mount Tai, like the sacrifice to -{后土}-; the emperor personally bowed throughout, wore upper yellow, and used music throughout.

sentences.zh: 江、淮間茅三脊為神藉，五色土益雜封。

translations.literal: Three-ridged thatch from between the Yangtze and Huai served as the spirit mat; five-colored earth was further added in mixed feng.
translations.idiomatic: Three-ridged thatch from between the Yangtze and Huai served as the spirit mat; five-colored earth was further added in mixed feng.

sentences.zh: 其封禪祠，夜若有光，晝有白雲出封中。

translations.literal: At the feng and shan shrines, at night there seemed to be light; by day white clouds emerged from within the feng.
translations.idiomatic: At the feng and shan shrines, at night there seemed to be light; by day white clouds emerged from within the feng.

sentences.zh: 天子從禪還，坐明堂，群臣更上壽頌功德。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven, returning from the shan, sat in the Bright Hall; the ministers in turn advanced longevity wishes praising merit and virtue.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, returning from the shan, sat in the Bright Hall; the ministers in turn offered longevity wishes praising merit and virtue.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕以眇身承至尊，兢兢焉惟德菲薄，不明於禮樂，故用事八神，遭天地況施，著見景象，屑然如有聞，震於怪物，欲止不敢，遂登封泰山，至於梁父，然後升壇肅然自新，嘉與士大夫更始，其以十月為元封元年。

translations.literal: An edict said: "We with a tiny body inherit the utmost honor, diligently and anxiously, yet virtue is thin and shallow, unclear in rites and music—therefore We served the Eight Spirits. Encountering Heaven and Earth's generous bestowal, manifest signs and scenes appeared; fragmentarily as if there were hearing; shaken by strange things, wishing to stop yet not daring, We thereupon ascended to perform feng on Mount Tai and reached Liangfu; then ascending the altar, solemnly We renewed ourselves, rejoicing to begin anew with scholar-officials—let the tenth month be the first year of Yuanfeng.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "I with a tiny body inherit the utmost honor, diligently and anxiously, yet my virtue is thin and shallow and unclear in rites and music—therefore I served the Eight Spirits. Encountering Heaven and Earth's generous bestowal, manifest signs appeared; fragmentarily as if there were hearing; shaken by strange things, wishing to stop yet not daring, I ascended to perform feng on Mount Tai and reached Liangfu; then ascending the altar I solemnly renewed myself, rejoicing to begin anew with scholar-officials—let the tenth month be the first year of Yuanfeng.

sentences.zh: 行所巡至，博、奉高、蛇丘、歷城、梁父，民田租逋賦，皆貸除之，無出今年算。

translations.literal: Where the tour reached—Bo, Fenggao, Sheqiu, Licheng, Liangfu—the people's field rents and overdue levies were all lent and remitted; none need pay this year's poll tax.
translations.idiomatic: Where the tour reached—Bo, Fenggao, Sheqiu, Licheng, Liangfu—field rents and overdue levies were all remitted; none need pay this year's poll tax.

sentences.zh: 賜天下民爵一級。

translations.literal: Grant all people under Heaven one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Grant all people under Heaven one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 」又以五載一巡狩，用事泰山，令諸侯各治邸泰山下。

translations.literal: " Moreover, every five years there would be an imperial tour and sacrifice at Mount Tai; the feudal lords were each to maintain lodges below Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: " Moreover, every five years there would be an imperial tour and sacrifice at Mount Tai; the feudal lords were each to maintain lodges below Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 天子既已封泰山，無風雨，而方士更言蓬萊諸神若將可得，於是上欣然庶幾遇之，復東至海上望焉。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven having already performed feng on Mount Tai without wind or rain, and the masters of the methods again saying the Penglai gods seemed about to be obtainable, the emperor thereupon gladly hoped he might meet them and again went east to the sea to gaze.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor having performed feng on Mount Tai without wind or rain, and the masters of the methods again saying the Penglai gods seemed about to be obtainable, he gladly hoped he might meet them and again went east to the sea to gaze.

sentences.zh: 上欲自浮海求蓬萊，群臣諫，莫能止。

translations.literal: The emperor wished himself to float on the sea to seek Penglai; the ministers remonstrated but none could stop him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished himself to float on the sea to seek Penglai; the ministers remonstrated but none could stop him.

sentences.zh: 東方朔曰：「夫仙者，得之自然，不必躁求。

translations.literal: Dongfang Shuo said: "As for immortals, obtaining them is natural—one need not urgently seek them.
translations.idiomatic: Dongfang Shuo said, "As for immortals, obtaining them is natural—one need not urgently seek them.

sentences.zh: 若其有道，不憂不得；

translations.literal: If one has the Way, one need not worry about not obtaining them;
translations.idiomatic: If one has the Way, one need not worry about not obtaining them;

sentences.zh: 若其無道，雖至蓬萊見仙人，亦無益也。

translations.literal: If one lacks the Way, even if one reaches Penglai and sees immortals, it is still of no benefit.
translations.idiomatic: If one lacks the Way, even reaching Penglai and seeing immortals is still of no benefit.

sentences.zh: 臣願陛下第還宮靜處以須之，仙人將自至。

translations.literal: Your servant wishes Your Majesty would simply return to the palace and dwell quietly to await them—the immortals will come of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant wishes Your Majesty would simply return to the palace and dwell quietly to await them—the immortals will come of themselves.

sentences.zh: 」上乃止。

translations.literal: " The emperor thereupon stopped.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor thereupon stopped.

sentences.zh: 會奉車霍子侯暴病，一日死。

translations.literal: It happened that Chief of the Imperial Carriages Huo Zihou fell violently ill and died in a day.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Chief of the Imperial Carriages Huo Zihou fell violently ill and died within a day.

sentences.zh: 子侯，去病子也，上甚悼之；

translations.literal: Zihou was Huo Qubing's son; the emperor greatly mourned him;
translations.idiomatic: Zihou was Huo Qubing's son; the emperor greatly mourned him;

sentences.zh: 乃遂去，並海上，北至碣石，巡自遼西，歷北邊，至九原。

translations.literal: he thereupon departed, followed the seacoast, north to Jieshi, toured from Liaodong west, passed the northern frontier, to Jiuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: he thereupon departed, followed the seacoast north to Jieshi, toured from Liaodong west, passed the northern frontier, and reached Jiuyuan.

sentences.zh: 五月，乃至甘泉。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he reached Sweet Springs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he reached Sweet Springs.

sentences.zh: 凡周行萬八千里-{云}-。

translations.literal: In all he circuit-traveled eighteen thousand li -{云}-.
translations.idiomatic: In all he circuit-traveled eighteen thousand li -{云}-.

sentences.zh: 先是，桑弘羊為治粟都尉，領大農，盡管天下鹽鐵。

translations.literal: Before this, Sang Hongyang was Superintendent of Grain, heading Grand Agriculture, fully controlling all salt and iron under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Before this, Sang Hongyang was Superintendent of Grain, heading Grand Agriculture, and fully controlled all salt and iron under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 弘羊作平准之法，令遠方各以其物如異時商賈所轉販者為賦而相灌輸。

translations.literal: Hongyang made the Equalization-Standard law, ordering distant regions each to take their goods like what merchants of former times turned and sold as tribute and mutually pour and transport.
translations.idiomatic: Hongyang instituted the Equalization-Standard law, ordering distant regions each to submit goods like those merchants of former times had traded and transported, as tribute for mutual exchange.

sentences.zh: 置平准於京師，都受天下委輸。

translations.literal: He established Equalization-Standard in the capital, fully receiving all the empire's consignments.
translations.idiomatic: He established Equalization-Standard offices in the capital to receive all the empire's consignments.

sentences.zh: 大農諸官，盡籠天下之貨物，貴即賣之，賤則買之，欲使富商大賈無所牟大利，而萬物不得騰踴。

translations.literal: Grand Agriculture's various offices fully caged all goods under Heaven—when costly sold them, when cheap bought them—wishing to make great wealthy merchants have no place to seize great profit, and the myriad things not leap and soar in price.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Agriculture's various offices monopolized all goods under Heaven—selling when prices were high, buying when they were low—wishing to deny great merchants huge profits and keep the myriad things from soaring in price.

sentences.zh: 至是，天子巡狩郡縣，所過賞賜，用帛百餘萬匹，錢金以巨萬計，皆取足大農。

translations.literal: At this time the Son of Heaven toured the commanderies and counties; rewards where he passed used more than a million bolts of silk, money and gold reckoned in huge myriads—all drawn fully from Grand Agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the emperor toured the commanderies and counties; rewards where he passed used more than a million bolts of silk and money and gold reckoned in huge sums—all drawn fully from Grand Agriculture.

sentences.zh: 弘羊又請令吏得入粟補官及罪人贖罪。

translations.literal: Hongyang again requested that officials be allowed to submit grain to fill offices and criminals ransom crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Hongyang again requested that officials be allowed to submit grain to purchase offices and criminals ransom their crimes.

sentences.zh: 山東漕粟益歲六百萬石，一歲之中，太倉、甘泉倉滿，邊餘谷，諸物均輸，帛五百萬匹，民不益賦而天下用饒。

translations.literal: East of the mountains transported grain increased yearly by six million shi; within one year the Grand Granary and Sweet Springs Granary were full, the frontier had surplus grain, various goods were equally transported, five million bolts of silk—the people did not increase levies yet use under Heaven was abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Grain transported from east of the mountains increased by six million shi yearly; within one year the Grand Granary and Sweet Springs Granary were full, the frontier had surplus grain, various goods were equally transported, and five million bolts of silk were stockpiled—the people paid no added levies yet the empire's resources were abundant.

sentences.zh: 於是弘羊賜爵左庶長，黃金再百斤焉。

translations.literal: Thereupon Hongyang was granted the noble rank Left Subordinate Elite and two hundred jin of gold.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Hongyang was granted the rank of Left Subordinate Elite and two hundred jin of gold.

sentences.zh: 是時小旱，上令官求雨。

translations.literal: At this time there was a small drought; the emperor ordered officials to seek rain.
translations.idiomatic: At this time there was a small drought; the emperor ordered officials to seek rain.

sentences.zh: 卜式言曰：「縣官當食租衣稅而已，今弘羊令吏坐市列肆，販物求利。

translations.literal: Bu Shi said: "The county officials should feed on land rent and garment taxes only—now Hongyang orders officials to sit in market rows and stalls, selling goods seeking profit.
translations.idiomatic: Bu Shi said, "The government should live on land rent and garment taxes only—now Hongyang orders officials to sit in market rows and stalls, selling goods for profit.

sentences.zh: 烹弘羊，天乃雨。

translations.literal: Cook Hongyang and Heaven will then rain.
translations.idiomatic: Cook Hongyang and Heaven will then rain.

sentences.zh: 」----5秋，有星孛於東井，後十餘日，有星孛於三台。

translations.literal: " ----5 In autumn, a broom star appeared at the Well; after more than ten days, a broom star appeared at the Three Terraces.
translations.idiomatic: " ----5 In autumn, a broom star appeared at the Well; after more than ten days, a broom star appeared at the Three Terraces.

sentences.zh: 望氣王朔言：「候獨見填星出如瓜，食頃，復入。

translations.literal: Qi-watcher Wang Shuo said: "When observing, I alone saw the Fill Star emerge like a melon; within the time to eat a meal, it re-entered.
translations.idiomatic: Qi-watcher Wang Shuo said, "When observing, I alone saw Saturn emerge like a melon; within a mealtime it re-entered.

sentences.zh: 」有司皆曰：「陛下建漢家封禪，天其報德星-{云}-。

translations.literal: " The responsible offices all said: "Your Majesty established Han's feng and shan; Heaven surely rewards with the Virtue Star -{云}-.
translations.idiomatic: " The responsible offices all said, "Your Majesty established Han's feng and shan; Heaven surely rewards with the Virtue Star -{云}-.

sentences.zh: 」----6齊懷王閎薨，無子，國除。

translations.literal: " ----6 King Huai of Qi Hong died; having no son, the state was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: " ----6 King Huai of Qi, Hong, died; having no son, the state was abolished.
